snippet.title: A "Totally" Normal Doki Summer Vacation! | A Summer's Requiem (DDLC Mod)
snippet.description:
The Dokis go on a "totally" normal summer trip...nothing bad happens...right? No horror or 4th wall breaking in this mod...okay maybe there is...
My first ever playable mod in celebration of 5000 subscribers!
👉Consider subscribing or becoming a channel member! (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwZOm-eYrDkJ04bEsXkyaRw/join)

👉Join my discord!: (https://discord.gg/4A83cGuuzH)

👉Download the mod here!: (https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/1mjtr06/a_summers_requiem_full_release/)
